title: botato
caption: Plans routes around obstacles and handles the repetitive movement and combat loops.
workflow: Read the current terrain and target, choose a traversable route and advance along it. If an obstacle changes the route, recalculate before moving; navigation feeds the wider automation loop.
benefit: Getting somewhere is easy until the straight line goes through a wall.
demo: Add obstacles, move the destination and recompute an A* route without cutting corners.
source: Botato navigation workflow and personal-site/dist/rocky-path.js obstacle-aware route demonstration.
boundary: A standalone grid planner. No game process, memory bridge or account is required.
